blocks.html: This method is used to send a notification.

types.name: notification
types.description: All information needed to send a notification.

children.name: to
children.description: The recipient of the notification. It can be email, phone number, or username, depending on the channel.

children.name: from
children.description: The sender of the notification. It can be email, phone number, or username, depending on the channel.

children.name: content
children.description: The content of the attachment, encoded as a binary string.

children.name: content_type
children.description: The MIME type of the attachment.

children.name: disposition
children.description: The disposition of the attachment, For example, "inline" or "attachment".

children.name: id
children.description: The ID, if the attachment is meant to be referenced within the body of the message.

children.name: channel
children.description: The channel through which the notification is sent, such as 'email' or 'sms'

children.name: template
children.description: The template name in the provider's system.

children.name: data
children.description: The data that gets passed over to the provider for rendering the notification.

children.name: provider_data
children.description: Additional data specific to the provider or channel. For example, cc and bcc for emails.

children.name: content
children.description: The content that gets passed to the provider.

children.name: text
children.description: the text content of the notification

children.name: html
children.description: the html content of the notification

types.name: Promise
types.description: The result of sending the notification.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the notification in the external system, if provided in the response
